source_title: EarFun Air Pro 4 falls 33% on Amazon to $53
source_excerpt:
Affiliate links on Android Authority may earn us a commission. Learn more.
The EarFun Air Pro 4 just dropped to $53.16 on Amazon, down from its $79.90 recommended retail price. That’s a $26 saving and a 33% discount off the RRP, which makes this a strong time to grab a feature-packed set of wireless earbuds for less.
For the money, the EarFun Air Pro 4 packs in a lot. It offers adaptive ANC, Bluetooth 5.4, multipoint support, and wireless charging. Audio codec support is also unusually wide for this price range, with LDAC, aptX Lossless/Adaptive, AAC, and SBC, plus LE Audio and Auracast compatibility. That gives it a lot of flexibility whether you’re listening from an Android phone, tablet, or another device.
Battery life is another big draw here. The earbuds are described as lasting around 9 to 11 hours per charge, with total battery life of about 52 to 54 hours when you include the case, depending on settings. You also get Google Fast Pair, a gaming mode, app-based EQ controls, and an IPX5 water-resistance rating for everyday use.
The EarFun Air Pro 4 is aimed at buyers who want a lot of features without spending close to $100, and this deal pushes it even further into bargain territory. It also holds a 4.4-star Amazon rating, which adds to the appeal. At $53.16 on Amazon, this is the kind of earbuds deal that stands out quickly.
